subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should maintainers split this umbrella into separate TUI, sessions_send, WeChat plugin-boundary, background-event isolation, and meaningful-activity items, and which owner should sponsor each path?
rationale: The remaining evidence spans core TUI/Gateway behavior, external WeChat plugin ownership, and product-level activity/background-event semantics; a single automated repair would likely cross owner boundaries and choose policy prematurely.

options.title: Split and route subproblems
options.body: Keep this issue open while focused items or PRs own each remaining behavior, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93255 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028 covering their narrower parts.

options.title: Keep as human-owned umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the coordinating tracker and block automation until maintainers reproduce the WeChat and flood/deadlock paths live.

options.title: Close only after linked work resolves it
options.body: Close this issue after focused linked fixes or maintainer decisions cover every reported behavior with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and route subproblems
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while focused items or PRs own each remaining behavior, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93255 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028 covering their narrower parts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined current-history signal across TUI/session utilities, WeChat docs, and sessions_send route work.
